# How much should you charge for this embroidery job?

> Price an embroidery job from your own machine time and costs: per-piece price that hits your target margin, quantity breaks, stitch-count sensitivity, and whether a per-1000-stitches rule loses money. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Input

- CSV cells and flags take plain decimal numbers with optional `$`, `%` and thousands commas. `4,50` (decimal comma) and `0x18` are rejected with an error, never read as 450 or 24.
